_meta.note: GroupKey accepts any non-whitespace value whose trimmed length is at least 8 and raw length is at most 128; its source comment says key length is doing all of the work. Registration allowlists room hashes but does not rate-limit guesses at an active key. No per-IP/key attempt counter or backoff exists in Program.cs.

scenario.target: an active room on either an open relay or a closed relay whose room hash is registered
scenario.costPerAttempt: one unauthenticated HTTP request, no backoff, no CAPTCHA, no per-IP counter
scenario.successCondition: A guessed live key returns the group's member list. On an open relay, misses return an empty room; on a closed relay, unregistered hashes return 403, so neither mode removes the online oracle for an active registered key.
